configs.name: admin.Config
configs.doc:
Config mounts an isolated console with explicitly enabled panel actions. All
callbacks, panels, Now and Rand must be concurrency safe and honor request
cancellation. Mount copies slices and descriptors. Limiter, middleware and
Logger remain caller-owned. Mount starts no goroutines. Origins must be exact
browser-visible origins behind rewriting proxies.

fields.name: Authenticate
fields.doc:
Authenticate is required and returns fresh customer-validated claims on every request.
Errors and invalid principals fail closed with admin_unauthenticated.
fields.default: Authenticate is required and returns fresh customer-validated claims on every request.

fields.name: Authorize
fields.doc:
Authorize optionally narrows resolved default grants. Errors hide targets with 404.
Navigation candidates are advisory; every data request is authorized separately.
Invalid requests also pass authorization with Navigation false. Only
individually valid parameters are included; required parameters may be
missing. Denied views remain indistinguishable from unknown views. An
authorized request with invalid parameters then returns 400.
POST lookups authorize the input scope before store access, then the resolved
record target before data access. Lookup input can contain secrets; do not log it.
fields.default: Authorize optionally narrows resolved default grants. Only individually valid parameters are included; required parameters may be missing.

fields.name: Middleware
fields.doc:
Middleware runs inside the protected wrapper, before Authenticate.
Its HTTP errors are sanitized and passed through ErrorHandler.
Middleware is optional; nil installs no additional middleware.
fields.default: Middleware is optional; nil installs no additional middleware.

fields.name: Panels
fields.doc:
Panels contains 1–64 sealed adapters; Mount copies the slice and descriptors.
Panels is required; configure 1 through 64 adapters.
fields.default: Panels is required; configure 1 through 64 adapters.

fields.name: Origins
fields.doc:
Origins contains up to 16 exact trusted browser-visible origins. Empty derives
the origin from TLS and Host; forwarded headers are never trusted.
fields.default: Empty derives the origin from TLS and Host; forwarded headers are never trusted.

fields.name: PublicPath
fields.doc: PublicPath is the trusted external literal path; defaults to the mount prefix.
fields.default: PublicPath is the trusted external literal path; defaults to the mount prefix.

fields.name: RateLimit
fields.doc:
RateLimit optionally replaces the bounded built-in principal bucket. A positive
duration refuses with 429 and Retry-After; errors refuse with admin_busy.
POST lookups are charged before store access, including guesses that miss.
Shell pages also use Access{Panel: "console", View: "shell"}; authenticated
Client shell routes and descriptor requests consume a token before navigation.
fields.default: RateLimit optionally replaces the bounded built-in principal bucket.

fields.name: MaxExpensive
fields.doc:
MaxExpensive bounds simultaneous expensive views, including lookup work:
1–64, default 2.
fields.default: MaxExpensive bounds simultaneous expensive views, including lookup work: 1–64, default 2.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.doc: Timeout bounds the full request, including middleware: 1ms–1m, default 10s.
fields.default: Timeout bounds the full request, including middleware: 1ms–1m, default 10s.

fields.name: Theme
fields.doc:
Theme contains trusted application presentation; copied by value at Mount.
Theme at zero selects the system scheme and default Echo Pro Admin title.
fields.default: Theme at zero selects the system scheme and default Echo Pro Admin title.

fields.name: Instance
fields.doc: Instance labels instance-local observations; required when a panel uses them.
fields.default: Instance labels instance-local observations; required when a panel uses them.

fields.name: ErrorHandler
fields.doc:
ErrorHandler optionally renders sanitized authentication and middleware problems.
If it leaves the response uncommitted, the shell renders the sanitized problem.
fields.default: ErrorHandler optionally renders sanitized authentication and middleware problems.

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc: Logger is optional and caller-owned; nil logs nothing. Only sanitized codes are logged.
fields.default: Logger is optional and caller-owned; nil logs nothing.

fields.name: Now
fields.doc: Now is a concurrency-safe clock; nil defaults to time.Now.
fields.default: Now is a concurrency-safe clock; nil defaults to time.Now.

fields.name: Keys
fields.doc:
Keys contains 1–8 signing/encryption keys of 32–64 bytes, copied at Mount.
Required for paginated or digest8 views, declared POST reads and actions.
The first signs and derives display digests,
and all verify tokens. Digests are stable with the same first key, change when it
rotates, and cannot be reversed without the key. Without Keys, unpaginated confidential reads use an ephemeral CSRF key
created at mount. Tokens expire on remount and cannot be shared across
instances.
fields.default: Required for paginated or digest8 views, declared POST reads and actions.

fields.name: CursorTTL
fields.doc:
CursorTTL bounds continuation lifetime: zero selects 15 minutes;
valid range 1s–24h.
fields.default: CursorTTL bounds continuation lifetime: zero selects 15 minutes; valid range 1s–24h.

fields.name: CSRFTTL
fields.doc:
CSRFTTL bounds synchronizer tokens: zero selects 1 hour; valid range
1s–24h.
fields.default: CSRFTTL bounds synchronizer tokens: zero selects 1 hour; valid range 1s–24h.

fields.name: ActorBoundCSRF
fields.doc: ActorBoundCSRF permits an empty session with actor-only token lifetime.
fields.default: ActorBoundCSRF permits an empty session with actor-only token lifetime.

fields.name: Audit
fields.doc: Audit is a caller-owned, concurrency-safe durable sink required for enabled actions.
fields.default: Audit is a caller-owned, concurrency-safe durable sink required for enabled actions.

fields.name: AllowUnauditedWrites
fields.doc:
AllowUnauditedWrites explicitly opts out of durable auditing. Mount warns
through Logger when actions are enabled; nil Logger remains silent.
fields.default: Mount warns through Logger when actions are enabled; nil Logger remains silent.

fields.name: RedactText
fields.doc: RedactText sanitizes free-text audit fields; nil retains only length and digest.
fields.default: RedactText sanitizes free-text audit fields; nil retains only length and digest.

fields.name: Rand
fields.doc:
Rand is a concurrency-safe nonce source; nil defaults to crypto/rand.Reader.
Custom readers must supply cryptographically secure bytes in production.
fields.default: Rand is a concurrency-safe nonce source; nil defaults to crypto/rand.Reader.

configs.name: admin.Theme
configs.doc:
Theme customizes trusted app presentation. Accent is #rrggbb and must reach
4.5:1 on the light canvas, panel and wash. Dark mode uses a readable lighter shade. Mount rejects accents that fail
contrast checks on light backgrounds. ExtraCSS is trusted application code.
Tone is empty, info, warning, or danger; Environment persists on the SPA header.

fields.name: Mode
fields.doc: Mode is the initial SPA color scheme: empty (system), light or dark. Viewers may override it.
fields.default: Mode is the initial SPA color scheme: empty (system), light or dark.

fields.name: Title
fields.doc: Title is trusted console text; defaults to Echo Pro Admin.
fields.default: Title is trusted console text; defaults to Echo Pro Admin.

fields.name: Accent
fields.doc:
Accent is an optional #rrggbb color. Light backgrounds require 4.5:1
contrast. Dark mode uses a lighter shade that reaches that contrast.
fields.default: Accent is an optional #rrggbb color. Light backgrounds require 4.5:1 contrast.

fields.name: Environment
fields.doc: Environment is optional trusted text shown on the SPA header.
fields.default: Environment is optional trusted text shown on the SPA header.

fields.name: Tone
fields.doc: Tone is empty, info, warning or danger.
fields.default: Tone is empty, info, warning or danger.

fields.name: ExtraCSS
fields.doc:
ExtraCSS is trusted application CSS, limited to 64 KiB.
ExtraCSS is optional; empty appends no application stylesheet.
fields.default: ExtraCSS is optional; empty appends no application stylesheet.

configs.name: audit.Capacity
configs.doc:
Capacity bounds event count and total serialized bytes, without eviction.
Both bounds must be positive. Duplicate recordings consume no capacity.

fields.name: Events
fields.doc: Events is required and must be positive; there is no default.
fields.default: Events is required and must be positive; there is no default.

fields.name: Bytes
fields.doc: Bytes is required and must be positive; there is no default.
fields.default: Bytes is required and must be positive; there is no default.

configs.name: audit.DenialConfig
configs.doc:
DenialConfig records denials only on routes or groups where installed. Install
it first, outside route authentication and authorization. Recording is synchronous
and fail-open by default. Callbacks must be concurrency safe and must not retain
the Echo context. Logger remains caller-owned.

fields.name: Schema
fields.doc: Schema is required, constructed and caller-owned.
fields.default: Schema is required, constructed and caller-owned.

fields.name: Recorder
fields.doc:
Recorder is required, caller-owned and must honor its recording
context.
fields.default: Recorder is required, caller-owned and must honor its recording context.

fields.name: Actor
fields.doc:
Actor is optional; nil or a failed callback uses Anonymous when no
Scope exists.
fields.default: Actor is optional; nil or a failed callback uses Anonymous when no Scope exists.

fields.name: Tenant
fields.doc:
Tenant is optional; nil or a failed callback uses the global tenant
when no Scope exists.
fields.default: Tenant is optional; nil or a failed callback uses the global tenant when no Scope exists.

fields.name: Statuses
fields.doc: default 401, 403; copied; 1–8 distinct 4xx codes
fields.default: default 401, 403; copied; 1–8 distinct 4xx codes.

fields.name: Action
fields.doc: default http.request.denied
fields.default: default http.request.denied.

fields.name: FailClosed
fields.doc:
FailClosed returns *DenialUnrecordedError on failed recording only
before response commitment; false preserves the original denial.
FailClosed defaults to false, preserving the original denial on recording failure.
fields.default: FailClosed defaults to false, preserving the original denial on recording failure.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.doc: default 500ms; 50ms–5s
fields.default: default 500ms; 50ms–5s.

fields.name: MaxInFlight
fields.doc: default 64; 1–1024
fields.default: default 64; 1–1024.

fields.name: RequestIDHeader
fields.doc: default X-Request-ID
fields.default: default X-Request-ID.

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc: optional; sanitized codes only
fields.default: optional; sanitized codes only.

configs.name: audit.MemoryStoreConfig
configs.doc: MemoryStoreConfig bounds process-local recording. Capacity is copied.

fields.name: Capacity
fields.doc:
Capacity requires positive event and byte bounds; there are no
defaults.
fields.default: Capacity requires positive event and byte bounds; there are no defaults.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.doc:
Timeout bounds every lock wait, each test-transaction call and each short
ReadView including its callback; default 5s, valid range 100ms–60s.
fields.default: Timeout bounds every lock wait, each test-transaction call and each short ReadView including its callback; default 5s, valid range 100ms–60s.

fields.name: Now
fields.doc: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.
fields.default: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.

configs.name: audit.MiddlewareConfig
configs.doc:
MiddlewareConfig maps requests to audit fields after routing and authentication.
Callbacks must support concurrent calls. RealIP comes from deployment configuration.
It is not a verified principal.

fields.name: Actor
fields.doc:
Actor is required; it resolves the verified principal and must not retain
c.
fields.default: Actor is required; it resolves the verified principal and must not retain c.

fields.name: Tenant
fields.doc:
Tenant is optional; nil uses the global (empty) tenant. It must not
retain c.
fields.default: Tenant is optional; nil uses the global (empty) tenant.

fields.name: RequestIDHeader
fields.doc:
RequestIDHeader defaults to X-Request-ID and must be a valid HTTP
field name.
fields.default: RequestIDHeader defaults to X-Request-ID and must be a valid HTTP field name.

configs.name: audit.ReaderConfig
configs.doc:
ReaderConfig is copied by NewReader. Schema, Access and Now are caller-owned
and must be concurrency safe. Query and Get ignore Access.

fields.name: Schema
fields.doc:
Schema is required and retained; it must carry the recording keyring
(non-nil Keys), including retained keys.
fields.default: Schema is required and retained; it must carry the recording keyring (non-nil Keys), including retained keys.

fields.name: Access
fields.doc: required for Reveal/Export; must commit independently, never provisionally
fields.default: required for Reveal/Export; must commit independently, never provisionally.

fields.name: TokenTTL
fields.doc: default 15m; 1m–24h
fields.default: default 15m; 1m–24h.

fields.name: MaxExports
fields.doc: default 2; 1–16 concurrent snapshot exports per Reader
fields.default: default 2; 1–16 concurrent snapshot exports per Reader.

fields.name: Now
fields.doc: default time.Now; must not block
fields.default: default time.Now; must not block.

configs.name: audit.RelayConfig
configs.doc:
RelayConfig configures a delivery coordinator and is copied by NewRelay.
Run owns one coordinator and one renewal worker.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc:
Name is required and identifies an already registered cursor: 1–64
ASCII lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting
with a letter.
fields.default: Name is required and identifies an already registered cursor: 1–64 ASCII lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter.

fields.name: Exporter
fields.doc:
Exporter is required and retained; it must honor cancellation and
declare the same representation as the registered cursor.
fields.default: Exporter is required and retained; it must honor cancellation and declare the same representation as the registered cursor.

fields.name: Witness
fields.doc:
Witness is an optional caller-owned durable progress witness; nil
disables it.
fields.default: Witness is an optional caller-owned durable progress witness; nil disables it.

fields.name: Batch
fields.doc:
Batch defaults to 256 (1–4096); MaxBytes defaults to 1 MiB
(64 KiB–8 MiB).
fields.default: Batch defaults to 256 (1–4096); MaxBytes defaults to 1 MiB (64 KiB–8 MiB).

fields.name: MaxBytes
fields.doc:
Batch defaults to 256 (1–4096); MaxBytes defaults to 1 MiB
(64 KiB–8 MiB).
fields.default: Batch defaults to 256 (1–4096); MaxBytes defaults to 1 MiB (64 KiB–8 MiB).

fields.name: Poll
fields.doc:
Poll defaults to 1s and must be positive. Lease defaults to 30s
(5s–5m). Backoff defaults to 1s (1s–5m).
fields.default: Poll defaults to 1s and must be positive. Lease defaults to 30s (5s–5m). Backoff defaults to 1s (1s–5m).

fields.name: Lease
fields.doc:
Poll defaults to 1s and must be positive. Lease defaults to 30s
(5s–5m). Backoff defaults to 1s (1s–5m).
fields.default: Poll defaults to 1s and must be positive. Lease defaults to 30s (5s–5m). Backoff defaults to 1s (1s–5m).

fields.name: Backoff
fields.doc:
Poll defaults to 1s and must be positive. Lease defaults to 30s
(5s–5m). Backoff defaults to 1s (1s–5m).
fields.default: Poll defaults to 1s and must be positive. Lease defaults to 30s (5s–5m). Backoff defaults to 1s (1s–5m).

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc:
Logger is currently unused; Relay emits no logs.
Logger is optional and caller-owned; nil is silent.
fields.default: Logger is optional and caller-owned; nil is silent.

configs.name: audit.SchemaConfig
configs.doc: SchemaConfig contains copied field registrations and projection policy.

fields.name: Fields
fields.doc:
Fields is copied; nil registers no metadata fields. At most 256 names
matching [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63} may be registered with valid classes.
fields.default: Fields is copied; nil registers no metadata fields.

fields.name: Policy
fields.doc:
Policy selects at-rest representations; its Modes map is copied by
construction. Zero selects redact defaults and requires HMAC keys.
fields.default: Zero selects redact defaults and requires HMAC keys.

fields.name: Keys
fields.doc:
Keys is an immutable caller-owned keyring retained by Schema. Keep it
usable independently of the Schema lifetime. Nil requires
Policy.AllowMaskFallback when an HMAC mode is selected.
fields.default: Nil requires Policy.AllowMaskFallback when an HMAC mode is selected.

fields.name: Now
fields.doc: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.
fields.default: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.

configs.name: auditadmin.PanelConfig
configs.doc:
PanelConfig configures the read-only Audit panel.
Reveal additionally requires Principal.Reveal.

fields.name: ID
fields.doc:
ID defaults to audit; use [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}, excluding api and
assets. Use a new ID or shell Keys when rebinding a store.
fields.default: ID defaults to audit; use [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}, excluding api and assets.

fields.name: Reader
fields.doc: Reader is required, concurrency safe and caller-owned; it is never closed.
fields.default: Reader is required, concurrency safe and caller-owned; it is never closed.

fields.name: ActorClass
fields.doc: ActorClass defaults to Identifier; SensitiveDigest8 is also accepted.
fields.default: ActorClass defaults to Identifier; SensitiveDigest8 is also accepted.

fields.name: TargetClass
fields.doc:
TargetClass defaults to Identifier; Public, SensitiveIP and SensitiveDigest8
are also accepted. Per-request class parameters override these probe defaults.
fields.default: TargetClass defaults to Identifier; Public, SensitiveIP and SensitiveDigest8 are also accepted. Per-request class parameters override these probe defaults.

fields.name: EnableReveal
fields.doc: EnableReveal adds the privileged POST read that records audit evidence; default false.
fields.default: EnableReveal adds the privileged POST read that records audit evidence; default false.

fields.name: PrincipalClass
fields.doc:
PrincipalClass classifies audit evidence for reveal actions; defaults to Identifier.
SensitiveDigest8 is also accepted.
fields.default: PrincipalClass classifies audit evidence for reveal actions; defaults to Identifier.

fields.name: RevealReasons
fields.doc:
RevealReasons is copied; empty selects incident_response,
customer_request and legal_request. Otherwise supply 1–16 distinct
[a-z0-9_]{1,64} codes.
fields.default: RevealReasons is copied; empty selects incident_response, customer_request and legal_request.

configs.name: auditpg.Roles
configs.doc:
Roles names the trusted NOLOGIN deployment owner and four independent runtime
roles. Empty fields default to audit_deployment, audit_recorder, audit_relay,
audit_maintenance and audit_reader. Roles must already exist; migration never
creates logins. Use keyed literals: adding Reader breaks positional literals.

fields.name: Deployment
fields.doc: Deployment defaults to audit_deployment.
fields.default: Deployment defaults to audit_deployment.

fields.name: Recorder
fields.doc: Recorder defaults to audit_recorder.
fields.default: Recorder defaults to audit_recorder.

fields.name: Relay
fields.doc: Relay defaults to audit_relay.
fields.default: Relay defaults to audit_relay.

fields.name: Maintenance
fields.doc: Maintenance defaults to audit_maintenance.
fields.default: Maintenance defaults to audit_maintenance.

fields.name: Reader
fields.doc: Reader defaults to audit_reader.
fields.default: Reader defaults to audit_reader.

configs.name: auditpg.SchemaConfig
configs.doc:
SchemaConfig selects a schema, exact role grants and operation deadlines.
An earlier caller deadline or cancellation still ends an operation first.
Values are copied by New.

fields.name: Schema
fields.doc: Schema defaults to public; use [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,62}.
fields.default: Schema defaults to public; use [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,62}.

fields.name: Roles
fields.doc:
Roles selects existing deployment and runtime roles. Empty fields use
Roles defaults; names must be distinct.
fields.default: Empty fields use Roles defaults; names must be distinct.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.doc:
Timeout bounds ordinary operations; zero uses 5s, valid range
100ms–60s.
fields.default: Timeout bounds ordinary operations; zero uses 5s, valid range 100ms–60s.

fields.name: MigrateTimeout
fields.doc:
MigrateTimeout bounds the whole migration in place of Timeout;
zero uses 1m, valid range 1s–1h.
fields.default: MigrateTimeout bounds the whole migration in place of Timeout; zero uses 1m, valid range 1s–1h.

configs.name: auth.APIKey
configs.doc:
APIKey configures a key-store scheme. Header empty means Authorization:
ApiKey; a configured header is also accepted. LookupTimeout defaults to 2s
(1ms–30s). The store remains caller-owned and must honor cancellation. No
goroutines start. Middleware construction copies the pepper ring and key
bytes. Cancellation and lookup failures become a sanitized *Failure rather
than exposing underlying store or context errors.

fields.name: Namespace
fields.doc: Namespace and Prefix are required and validated during middleware construction.
fields.default: Namespace and Prefix are required and validated during middleware construction.

fields.name: Prefix
fields.doc: Namespace and Prefix are required and validated during middleware construction.
fields.default: Namespace and Prefix are required and validated during middleware construction.

fields.name: Header
fields.doc: Header empty selects Authorization: ApiKey; a configured header is also accepted.
fields.default: Header empty selects Authorization: ApiKey; a configured header is also accepted.

fields.name: Peppers
fields.doc: Peppers is required; construction copies its versions and key bytes.
fields.default: Peppers is required; construction copies its versions and key bytes.

fields.name: Store
fields.doc: Store is required, caller-owned and must return current revocation state.
fields.default: Store is required, caller-owned and must return current revocation state.

fields.name: LookupTimeout
fields.doc: LookupTimeout defaults to 2s; valid range 1ms through 30s.
fields.default: LookupTimeout defaults to 2s; valid range 1ms through 30s.

configs.name: auth.BearerConfig
configs.doc:
BearerConfig describes one trusted issuer. HTTPS is mandatory, including
discovery jwks_uri.

fields.name: Namespace
fields.default: Namespace names principal IDs using [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}; required. Issuer is the exact trusted issuer string, required and at most 2048 bytes.

fields.name: Issuer
fields.default: Namespace names principal IDs using [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}; required. Issuer is the exact trusted issuer string, required and at most 2048 bytes.

fields.name: Audiences
fields.doc: Audiences is copied; require 1–32 accepted values, each 1–512 bytes.
fields.default: Audiences is copied; require 1–32 accepted values, each 1–512 bytes.

fields.name: JWKSURL
fields.doc: JWKSURL and DiscoveryURL are HTTPS sources; set exactly one.
fields.default: JWKSURL and DiscoveryURL are HTTPS sources; set exactly one.

fields.name: DiscoveryURL
fields.doc: JWKSURL and DiscoveryURL are HTTPS sources; set exactly one.
fields.default: JWKSURL and DiscoveryURL are HTTPS sources; set exactly one.

fields.name: AllowedJWKSHosts
fields.doc:
AllowedJWKSHosts is copied, with at most 32 exact jwks_uri hosts,
including a port only when the URL has one. Empty permits only the
discovery host for the discovered JWKS URL.
fields.default: Empty permits only the discovery host for the discovered JWKS URL.

fields.name: Algorithms
fields.doc:
Algorithms is copied; empty selects RS256, PS256, ES256 and EdDSA.
At most ten RSA, RSA-PSS, ECDSA or EdDSA algorithms are accepted.
fields.default: Algorithms is copied; empty selects RS256, PS256, ES256 and EdDSA.

fields.name: Profile
fields.doc:
Profile defaults to ProfileAccessToken; ProfileJWT is the other valid
value.
fields.default: Profile defaults to ProfileAccessToken; ProfileJWT is the other valid value.

fields.name: ClockSkew
fields.doc:
ClockSkew defaults to 30s; nonzero values must be positive and at
most 2m.
fields.default: ClockSkew defaults to 30s; nonzero values must be positive and at most 2m.

fields.name: SubjectClaim
fields.doc:
SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp
if absent. KindClaim empty selects User. TenantClaim is used only
with TrustTenantClaim.
fields.default: SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp if absent. KindClaim empty selects User.

fields.name: ScopeClaim
fields.doc:
SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp
if absent. KindClaim empty selects User. TenantClaim is used only
with TrustTenantClaim.
fields.default: SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp if absent. KindClaim empty selects User.

fields.name: KindClaim
fields.doc:
SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp
if absent. KindClaim empty selects User. TenantClaim is used only
with TrustTenantClaim.
fields.default: SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp if absent. KindClaim empty selects User.

fields.name: TenantClaim
fields.doc:
SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp
if absent. KindClaim empty selects User. TenantClaim is used only
with TrustTenantClaim.
fields.default: SubjectClaim defaults to sub; ScopeClaim defaults to scope, then scp if absent. KindClaim empty selects User.

fields.name: TrustTenantClaim
fields.doc:
TrustTenantClaim explicitly permits TenantClaim to restrict the
principal; default false.
fields.default: TrustTenantClaim explicitly permits TenantClaim to restrict the principal; default false.

fields.name: ClaimAllowlist
fields.doc:
ClaimAllowlist is copied; empty retains no extra claims. At most 32
names of 1–128 bytes are accepted; retained values must satisfy
PrincipalConfig.
fields.default: ClaimAllowlist is copied; empty retains no extra claims.

fields.name: Client
fields.doc:
Client is optional; nil uses a zero http.Client. A private shallow
copy shares its transport, disables cookies and restricts redirects.
fields.default: Client is optional; nil uses a zero http.Client.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.doc:
Timeout bounds each fetch independently: zero selects 5s; valid range
1ms–30s.
fields.default: Timeout bounds each fetch independently: zero selects 5s; valid range 1ms–30s.

fields.name: Now
fields.doc: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.
fields.default: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc:
Logger is caller-owned; nil is silent. Only sanitized categories for
skipped JWKS entries are logged.
fields.default: Logger is caller-owned; nil is silent.

configs.name: auth.Config
configs.doc:
Config authenticates before quota. Maps and slices are copied. Caller-owned
stores, logger and clock must be concurrency safe. ToMiddleware starts no work.

fields.name: Schemes
fields.doc:
Schemes requires 1–32 named schemes with distinct namespaces.
Construction compiles a private map and retains constructed Bearers
and APIKey stores.
fields.default: Schemes requires 1–32 named schemes with distinct namespaces.

fields.name: Fallback
fields.doc:
Fallback is required; choose Deny, Anonymous or Require. Its zero
value is invalid.
fields.default: Fallback is required; choose Deny, Anonymous or Require. Its zero value is invalid.

fields.name: Report
fields.doc:
Report optionally validates every effective operation's scheme/scopes
at startup. Its operation policies are copied during construction; do
not mutate it during that call.
fields.default: Report optionally validates every effective operation's scheme/scopes at startup.

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc: Logger is retained and caller-owned; nil is silent.
fields.default: Logger is retained and caller-owned; nil is silent.

fields.name: Now
fields.doc:
Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses each scheme's
clock (time.Now unless a BearerConfig.Now was supplied).
fields.default: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses each scheme's clock (time.Now unless a BearerConfig.Now was supplied).

configs.name: auth.KeyOptions
configs.doc:
KeyOptions controls issuance; Kind defaults to Service. A zero expiration
permits a nonexpiring credential. Callers own revocation and record persistence.

fields.name: Kind
fields.doc: Kind defaults to Service; User is the other accepted value.
fields.default: Kind defaults to Service; User is the other accepted value.

fields.name: Scopes
fields.doc: Scopes is optional; empty grants none. IssueKey copies the slice.
fields.default: Scopes is optional; empty grants none.

fields.name: TenantRestriction
fields.doc: TenantRestriction is optional; empty leaves membership resolution to the application.
fields.default: TenantRestriction is optional; empty leaves membership resolution to the application.

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.doc: ExpiresAt at zero permits a nonexpiring credential.
fields.default: ExpiresAt at zero permits a nonexpiring credential.

configs.name: auth.PrincipalConfig
configs.doc:
PrincipalConfig contains already verified principal data. Never populate it
from unverified headers or tool arguments. Claims must be explicitly allowlisted
by the verifier. Inputs are copied.

fields.name: Namespace
fields.doc:
Namespace is required and matches [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}. Subject is
required, valid UTF-8 and at most 16 KiB. Scheme is required and at
most 64 bytes.
fields.default: Namespace is required and matches [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}. Subject is required, valid UTF-8 and at most 16 KiB. Scheme is required and at most 64 bytes.

fields.name: Subject
fields.doc:
Namespace is required and matches [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}. Subject is
required, valid UTF-8 and at most 16 KiB. Scheme is required and at
most 64 bytes.
fields.default: Namespace is required and matches [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}. Subject is required, valid UTF-8 and at most 16 KiB. Scheme is required and at most 64 bytes.

fields.name: Scheme
fields.doc:
Namespace is required and matches [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}. Subject is
required, valid UTF-8 and at most 16 KiB. Scheme is required and at
most 64 bytes.
fields.default: Namespace is required and matches [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}. Subject is required, valid UTF-8 and at most 16 KiB. Scheme is required and at most 64 bytes.

fields.name: Kind
fields.doc: Kind must be User or Service; the zero value is invalid.
fields.default: Kind must be User or Service; the zero value is invalid.

fields.name: Scopes
fields.doc:
Scopes is copied; empty grants none. At most 64 visible ASCII
(0x21–0x7E) scopes of 1–128 bytes are accepted.
fields.default: Scopes is copied; empty grants none.

fields.name: TenantRestriction
fields.doc:
TenantRestriction is optional and matches [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128} when
set. KeyID is optional and at most 256 bytes.
fields.default: TenantRestriction is optional and matches [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128} when set. KeyID is optional and at most 256 bytes.

fields.name: KeyID
fields.doc:
TenantRestriction is optional and matches [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128} when
set. KeyID is optional and at most 256 bytes.
fields.default: TenantRestriction is optional and matches [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128} when set. KeyID is optional and at most 256 bytes.

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.doc:
ExpiresAt is the verified expiry; zero represents a nonexpiring API
key. NewPrincipal stores it without checking whether it is in the
future.
fields.default: ExpiresAt is the verified expiry; zero represents a nonexpiring API key.

fields.name: Claims
fields.doc:
Claims is copied; nil retains none. At most 32 UTF-8 entries fit,
with names of 1–128 bytes and values of at most 1024 bytes.
fields.default: Claims is copied; nil retains none.

configs.name: authbind.QuotaConfig
configs.doc:
QuotaConfig explicitly controls trusted IP and anonymous metering. With no
trusted extractor authenticated traffic omits IP; AnonymousByIP requires a
valid IP.

fields.name: IP
fields.doc:
IP is a retained, concurrency-safe trusted extractor. Nil uses
c.RealIP only when Echo.IPExtractor is configured.
fields.default: Nil uses c.RealIP only when Echo.IPExtractor is configured.

fields.name: AnonymousByIP
fields.doc:
AnonymousByIP permits anonymous metering by a valid trusted IP;
default false.
fields.default: AnonymousByIP permits anonymous metering by a valid trusted IP; default false.

configs.name: execution.Effect
configs.doc: Effect names an immutable provider and defines request replay rules.

fields.name: Name
fields.doc: Name and Provider are required; they identify the effect and provider replay rules.
fields.default: Name and Provider are required; they identify the effect and provider replay rules.

fields.name: Provider
fields.doc: Name and Provider are required; they identify the effect and provider replay rules.
fields.default: Name and Provider are required; they identify the effect and provider replay rules.

fields.name: ReplayWindow
fields.doc: ReplayWindow at zero declares no provider replay window; nonzero must exceed RequestTimeout plus 5m.
fields.default: ReplayWindow at zero declares no provider replay window; nonzero must exceed RequestTimeout plus 5m.

fields.name: RequestTimeout
fields.doc: RequestTimeout is required, positive and at most 5m, in whole microseconds.
fields.default: RequestTimeout is required, positive and at most 5m, in whole microseconds.

configs.name: execution.FingerprintSpec
configs.doc:
FingerprintSpec is the immutable descriptor included in the safety digest.
Built-in profiles are "http/v1" and "http/v1+json", with Version "v1".
Custom profiles require both Version and CustomVersion. ConfigDigest commits
to application configuration. Nil Headers selects the six standard headers;
a nonnil empty slice selects none. Callers retain ownership of Headers.

fields.name: Profile
fields.doc: Profile empty selects http/v1 during policy construction.
fields.default: Profile empty selects http/v1 during policy construction.

fields.name: Version
fields.doc: Version defaults to v1 when Profile is defaulted; custom profiles require it explicitly.
fields.default: Version defaults to v1 when Profile is defaulted; custom profiles require it explicitly.

fields.name: Headers
fields.doc: Headers nil selects the six standard headers; an explicit empty slice selects none.
fields.default: Headers nil selects the six standard headers; an explicit empty slice selects none.

fields.name: CustomVersion
fields.doc: CustomVersion is required for custom profiles and empty for built-in profiles.
fields.default: CustomVersion is required for custom profiles and empty for built-in profiles.

fields.name: ConfigDigest
fields.doc: ConfigDigest at zero contributes a zero configuration digest; set it when application configuration changes behavior.
fields.default: ConfigDigest at zero contributes a zero configuration digest; set it when application configuration changes behavior.

configs.name: execution.JournalConfig
configs.doc:
JournalConfig configures a journal. Policies and their slices are copied.
Store remains caller-owned and must outlive the Journal. New starts no
goroutines. Callbacks must honor their context; record and result redaction
are application responsibilities. The limit fields form the namespace Limits.

Redact, RedactEvidence, OnTransition and OnError run synchronously. They
may run concurrently for different attempts and operator calls. They must
support concurrent calls. Attempt methods hold the attempt mutex while
invoking these callbacks. This includes Intent, Resend, Renew, Release,
Complete, Fail, FailedProven, Uncertain, RecordSendTiming and finalization
in Do. Callbacks must return promptly. Calling the same Attempt, or waiting
for work that calls it, would deadlock. OnTransition observes an already committed record and cannot
affect the commit; OnError observes errors without replacing the answer.

fields.name: Namespace
fields.doc: Namespace is required: 1–64 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.
fields.default: Namespace is required: 1–64 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.

fields.name: Store
fields.doc:
Store is required, retained and caller-owned; it must satisfy Store
cancellation, copying and concurrency requirements.
fields.default: Store is required, retained and caller-owned; it must satisfy Store cancellation, copying and concurrency requirements.

fields.name: Policies
fields.doc:
Policies requires 1–1024 named policies; New copies the map and
nested slices.
fields.default: Policies requires 1–1024 named policies; New copies the map and nested slices.

fields.name: OpTimeout
fields.default: OpTimeout defaults to 5s (1–30s); CompleteTimeout to 10s (1–30s); ReconcileTimeout to 30s (1s–5m); ReconcileLease to 1m (2s–10m) and must exceed ReconcileTimeout + OpTimeout.

fields.name: CompleteTimeout
fields.default: OpTimeout defaults to 5s (1–30s); CompleteTimeout to 10s (1–30s); ReconcileTimeout to 30s (1s–5m); ReconcileLease to 1m (2s–10m) and must exceed ReconcileTimeout + OpTimeout.

fields.name: ReconcileTimeout
fields.default: OpTimeout defaults to 5s (1–30s); CompleteTimeout to 10s (1–30s); ReconcileTimeout to 30s (1s–5m); ReconcileLease to 1m (2s–10m) and must exceed ReconcileTimeout + OpTimeout.

fields.name: ReconcileLease
fields.default: OpTimeout defaults to 5s (1–30s); CompleteTimeout to 10s (1–30s); ReconcileTimeout to 30s (1s–5m); ReconcileLease to 1m (2s–10m) and must exceed ReconcileTimeout + OpTimeout.

fields.name: MaxResultBytes
fields.doc:
MaxResultBytes defaults to 64 KiB (1 byte–1 MiB); MaxUnresolvedPerTenant
defaults to 1000 and must be positive.
fields.default: MaxResultBytes defaults to 64 KiB (1 byte–1 MiB); MaxUnresolvedPerTenant defaults to 1000 and must be positive.

fields.name: MaxUnresolvedPerTenant
fields.doc:
MaxResultBytes defaults to 64 KiB (1 byte–1 MiB); MaxUnresolvedPerTenant
defaults to 1000 and must be positive.
fields.default: MaxResultBytes defaults to 64 KiB (1 byte–1 MiB); MaxUnresolvedPerTenant defaults to 1000 and must be positive.

fields.name: MaxNamespaceRecords
fields.doc:
MaxNamespaceRecords defaults to 5,000,000 and MaxNamespaceBytes to 20
GiB; both must be positive after defaults.
fields.default: MaxNamespaceRecords defaults to 5,000,000 and MaxNamespaceBytes to 20 GiB; both must be positive after defaults.

fields.name: MaxNamespaceBytes
fields.doc:
MaxNamespaceRecords defaults to 5,000,000 and MaxNamespaceBytes to 20
GiB; both must be positive after defaults.
fields.default: MaxNamespaceRecords defaults to 5,000,000 and MaxNamespaceBytes to 20 GiB; both must be positive after defaults.

fields.name: BudgetShards
fields.doc: BudgetShards defaults to 16; valid range 1–256.
fields.default: BudgetShards defaults to 16; valid range 1–256.

fields.name: Redact
fields.doc:
Redact optionally transforms copied results before storage; nil
preserves them.
fields.default: Redact optionally transforms copied results before storage; nil preserves them.

fields.name: RedactEvidence
fields.doc:
RedactEvidence optionally transforms recorded diagnostics before storage; nil
preserves it.
fields.default: RedactEvidence optionally transforms recorded diagnostics before storage; nil preserves it.

fields.name: OnTransition
fields.doc:
OnTransition optionally observes owned committed records; nil is
silent.
fields.default: OnTransition optionally observes owned committed records; nil is silent.

fields.name: OnError
fields.doc: OnError optionally observes errors; nil is silent.
fields.default: OnError optionally observes errors; nil is silent.

configs.name: execution.Limits
configs.doc: Limits are immutable per namespace; zero values select documented defaults.

fields.name: MaxResultBytes
fields.doc: MaxResultBytes defaults to 64 KiB; valid range 1 byte through 1 MiB.
fields.default: MaxResultBytes defaults to 64 KiB; valid range 1 byte through 1 MiB.

fields.name: MaxUnresolvedPerTenant
fields.doc: MaxUnresolvedPerTenant defaults to 1000 and must be positive.
fields.default: MaxUnresolvedPerTenant defaults to 1000 and must be positive.

fields.name: MaxNamespaceRecords
fields.doc: MaxNamespaceRecords defaults to 5000000 and must be positive.
fields.default: MaxNamespaceRecords defaults to 5000000 and must be positive.

fields.name: MaxNamespaceBytes
fields.doc: MaxNamespaceBytes defaults to 20 GiB of logical charges and must be positive.
fields.default: MaxNamespaceBytes defaults to 20 GiB of logical charges and must be positive.

fields.name: BudgetShards
fields.doc: BudgetShards defaults to 16; valid range 1 through 256.
fields.default: BudgetShards defaults to 16; valid range 1 through 256.

configs.name: execution.MiddlewareConfig
configs.doc:
MiddlewareConfig protects one configured operation. Callbacks run
synchronously and must not retain c. Header slices are copied during
construction. Journal and callbacks remain caller-owned. Constructed
middleware supports concurrent requests; all callbacks must be concurrency
safe and honor request cancellation. It starts no goroutines that outlive a
request.

fields.name: Journal
fields.doc: Journal is required, retained and caller-owned.
fields.default: Journal is required, retained and caller-owned.

fields.name: Identity
fields.doc:
Identity is required and resolves trusted tenant and subject per
request.
fields.default: Identity is required and resolves trusted tenant and subject per request.

fields.name: Operation
fields.doc:
Operation must name a configured ExternalMode policy; empty is
invalid.
fields.default: Operation must name a configured ExternalMode policy; empty is invalid.

fields.name: ReplayCheck
fields.doc:
ReplayCheck is required and authorizes current access on every
invocation.
fields.default: ReplayCheck is required and authorizes current access on every invocation.

fields.name: ClassifyStatus
fields.doc:
ClassifyStatus optionally maps status to Completed or Failed; nil
leaves classification explicit through Classify. It may also return
an empty state.
fields.default: ClassifyStatus optionally maps status to Completed or Failed; nil leaves classification explicit through Classify. It may also return an empty state.

fields.name: Header
fields.doc:
Header defaults to Idempotency-Key and must be a valid HTTP field
name.
fields.default: Header defaults to Idempotency-Key and must be a valid HTTP field name.

fields.name: Fingerprint
fields.type: func(context.Context, *http.Request, string, map[string]string, FingerprintSpec, int64) ([32]byte, error)
fields.default: Fingerprint defaults to FingerprintHTTP for built-in HTTP profiles; custom profiles require a callback with FingerprintHTTP's bounds and cancellation requirements.

fields.name: MaxFingerprintBytes
fields.doc: MaxFingerprintBytes defaults to 1 MiB; valid range 1 byte–8 MiB.
fields.default: MaxFingerprintBytes defaults to 1 MiB; valid range 1 byte–8 MiB.

fields.name: MaxResponseBytes
fields.doc: MaxResponseBytes defaults to 1 MiB; valid range 1 byte–8 MiB.
fields.default: MaxResponseBytes defaults to 1 MiB; valid range 1 byte–8 MiB.

fields.name: ReplayHeaders
fields.doc:
ReplayHeaders is copied; nil selects Content-Type, nonnil empty
selects none. At most 64 distinct allowed HTTP field names fit;
hop-by-hop, framing, Set-Cookie and Idempotent-Replayed fields are
forbidden.
fields.default: ReplayHeaders is copied; nil selects Content-Type, nonnil empty selects none.

fields.name: NotExecuted
fields.doc:
NotExecuted runs once on every no-work path, including
validation/refusal; nil is silent.
fields.default: NotExecuted runs once on every no-work path, including validation/refusal; nil is silent.

fields.name: ProblemHandler
fields.doc:
ProblemHandler optionally renders execution problems; nil uses RFC
9457.
fields.default: ProblemHandler optionally renders execution problems; nil uses RFC 9457.

fields.name: OnError
fields.doc:
OnError optionally observes storage/finalization and transport
failures without changing the answer; nil is silent.
fields.default: OnError optionally observes storage/finalization and transport failures without changing the answer; nil is silent.

configs.name: execution.Policy
configs.doc:
Policy declares effects and their safety rules. New owns copied slices.
Zero tunables select Lease=1 minute, ResultRetention=24 hours,
KeyRetention=7 days. Effects require explicit timeouts. Backend selection
comes only from the injected Store; a policy carries no storage selector.
An empty fingerprint selects http/v1; nil Headers selects conditional and
content headers, while an explicit empty slice selects none. An empty Mode
selects ExternalMode; TransactionalMode requires no effects, a zero Lease and
an empty ReconcilerVersion.

fields.name: SafetyVersion
fields.doc: SafetyVersion is required and versions the operation's safety rules.
fields.default: SafetyVersion is required and versions the operation's safety rules.

fields.name: Scope
fields.doc: Scope empty defaults to the configured operation name in Journal.New.
fields.default: Scope empty defaults to the configured operation name in Journal.New.

fields.name: ReconcilerVersion
fields.doc: ReconcilerVersion is required for external mode and empty for transactional mode.
fields.default: ReconcilerVersion is required for external mode and empty for transactional mode.

fields.name: Effects
fields.doc: Effects requires 1 through 8 entries in external mode; transactional mode requires none.
fields.default: Effects requires 1 through 8 entries in external mode; transactional mode requires none.

fields.name: Fingerprint
fields.doc: Fingerprint at zero selects http/v1 with its default header set.
fields.default: Fingerprint at zero selects http/v1 with its default header set.

fields.name: Lease
fields.doc: Lease defaults to 1m in external mode; transactional mode requires zero.
fields.default: Lease defaults to 1m in external mode; transactional mode requires zero.

fields.name: ResultRetention
fields.doc: ResultRetention defaults to 24h and must be positive.
fields.default: ResultRetention defaults to 24h and must be positive.

fields.name: KeyRetention
fields.doc: KeyRetention defaults to 7 days and must be at least ResultRetention.
fields.default: KeyRetention defaults to 7 days and must be at least ResultRetention.

fields.name: Mode
fields.doc: Mode empty selects ExternalMode; TransactionalMode is explicit.
fields.default: Mode empty selects ExternalMode; TransactionalMode is explicit.

configs.name: execution.ReconcileSchedulerConfig
configs.doc:
ReconcileSchedulerConfig configures an opt-in ReconcileScheduler.

Authorization callbacks receive a child context bounded by the journal's
OpTimeout.

The Operator, its Store, Logger and callback closures remain caller-owned and
must stay usable until Run and any explicit pending-handle retry finish.
Callbacks run serially within one scheduler but must tolerate concurrency
with other schedulers and manual recovery against the same namespace.

fields.name: Operator
fields.doc:
Operator is required and retained; its journal's Store must implement
ScheduledReconcileStore.
fields.default: Operator is required and retained; its journal's Store must implement ScheduledReconcileStore.

fields.name: Scopes
fields.doc:
Scopes is copied and requires 1–1024 registered policy scopes, not
operation aliases. Reconciler and Completion callbacks are retained.
fields.default: Scopes is copied and requires 1–1024 registered policy scopes, not operation aliases.

fields.name: PollInterval
fields.doc:
PollInterval defaults to 30s; valid range 1s–1h, measured after each
pass. It is not a recovery-latency guarantee.
fields.default: PollInterval defaults to 30s; valid range 1s–1h, measured after each pass.

fields.name: PageSize
fields.doc: PageSize defaults to 25; valid range 1–100 examined records per pass.
fields.default: PageSize defaults to 25; valid range 1–100 examined records per pass.

fields.name: AuthorizeNamespace
fields.doc:
AuthorizeNamespace is required and retained; it runs before each
ListUncertain. Errors stop Run.
fields.default: AuthorizeNamespace is required and retained; it runs before each ListUncertain.

fields.name: AuthorizeTarget
fields.doc:
AuthorizeTarget is required and retained; it runs before preparing
each candidate. False skips the target; errors stop Run.
fields.default: AuthorizeTarget is required and retained; it runs before preparing each candidate.

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc:
Logger is retained and caller-owned; nil is silent. It receives only
bounded categories, never refs, principal data or error text.
fields.default: Logger is retained and caller-owned; nil is silent.

configs.name: executionadmin.Config
configs.doc:
Config configures the panel. The Operator, its Store, and the Reconciler and
Completion callbacks stay caller-owned and must be safe for concurrent use.
Keep them usable for the panel's whole lifetime, including retries of retained
pending reconcile handles. New starts no goroutines. Reconciler and Completion
honor context cancellation. Lookup keys contain the authorized tenant, subject
and scope from the body. Use admin.Config.Authorize to narrow authorization.

fields.name: Operator
fields.doc: Operator is required, retained and must come from Journal.Operator.
fields.default: Operator is required, retained and must come from Journal.Operator.

fields.name: Reconciler
fields.doc:
Reconciler is optional and retained; nil disables reconciliation.
Sending requires the library claim's Resend permit.
fields.default: Reconciler is optional and retained; nil disables reconciliation. Sending requires the library claim's Resend permit.

fields.name: Completion
fields.doc: Completion is optional and retained; nonnil requires Reconciler.
fields.default: Completion is optional and retained; nonnil requires Reconciler.

fields.name: EnableResolve
fields.doc: EnableResolve opts into destructive resolution; default false.
fields.default: EnableResolve opts into destructive resolution; default false.

fields.name: MaxPending
fields.doc:
MaxPending defaults to 128 (1–1000); at the cap new reconciles are
refused and ambiguous handles are never evicted.
fields.default: MaxPending defaults to 128 (1–1000); at the cap new reconciles are refused and ambiguous handles are never evicted.

configs.name: pgstore.StoreConfig
configs.doc:
StoreConfig selects a schema and optionally binds an instance to one namespace.
Namespace, when supplied, makes New check its persisted shard count and caps
against Limits; Begin must use those same caps.
With no Namespace, Begin checks its own Limits against the persisted namespace.
The caller's pgx query mode is never changed.

An earlier caller deadline or cancellation still ends migration first, and
statements keep the one-second lock timeout. New validates MigrateTimeout and rejects out-of-range values. New and Store
operations do not use it as their deadline.

fields.name: Schema
fields.doc:
Schema defaults to public; valid identifiers are 1–63 UTF-8 bytes
without NUL or "$$". Namespace is optional; when set it is 1–64 UTF-8
bytes without controls and binds New to the namespace caps.
fields.default: Schema defaults to public; valid identifiers are 1–63 UTF-8 bytes without NUL or "$$". Namespace is optional; when set it is 1–64 UTF-8 bytes without controls and binds New to the namespace caps.

fields.name: Namespace
fields.doc:
Schema defaults to public; valid identifiers are 1–63 UTF-8 bytes
without NUL or "$$". Namespace is optional; when set it is 1–64 UTF-8
bytes without controls and binds New to the namespace caps.
fields.default: Schema defaults to public; valid identifiers are 1–63 UTF-8 bytes without NUL or "$$". Namespace is optional; when set it is 1–64 UTF-8 bytes without controls and binds New to the namespace caps.

fields.name: Limits
fields.doc:
Limits selects namespace caps; zero fields select execution.Limits
defaults.
fields.default: Limits selects namespace caps; zero fields select execution.Limits defaults.

fields.name: MigrateTimeout
fields.doc:
MigrateTimeout bounds all of Migrate: pool acquisition, DDL, catalog
validation and COMMIT. It defaults to 1m; valid range 1s–1h.
fields.default: It defaults to 1m; valid range 1s–1h.

configs.name: pgstore.TxRunnerConfig
configs.doc:
TxRunnerConfig configures a TxRunner. An empty policy Scope defaults to the
operation name and aliases sharing a scope must share one safety policy.

A Journal and TxRunner sharing a namespace and scope must use the same
normalized safety policy. Each invocation checks retained records.

fields.name: Namespace
fields.doc: Namespace is required: 1–64 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.
fields.default: Namespace is required: 1–64 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.

fields.name: Policies
fields.doc:
Policies requires 1–1024 TransactionalMode policies; the map and
slices are copied.
fields.default: Policies requires 1–1024 TransactionalMode policies; the map and slices are copied.

fields.name: Limits
fields.doc:
Limits zero fields select execution.Limits defaults; caps must match
a namespace-bound Store.
fields.default: Limits zero fields select execution.Limits defaults; caps must match a namespace-bound Store.

fields.name: OpTimeout
fields.doc:
OpTimeout defaults to 5s; valid range 1–30s, for starting or
finishing an operation, including COMMIT.
fields.default: OpTimeout defaults to 5s; valid range 1–30s, for starting or finishing an operation, including COMMIT.

fields.name: TxTimeout
fields.doc:
TxTimeout bounds the total call; defaults to 30s, valid range 1–60s,
shortened by the caller deadline.
fields.default: TxTimeout bounds the total call; defaults to 30s, valid range 1–60s, shortened by the caller deadline.

fields.name: CleanupTimeout
fields.doc:
CleanupTimeout defaults to 5s; valid range 1–30s, for detached
rollback.
fields.default: CleanupTimeout defaults to 5s; valid range 1–30s, for detached rollback.

fields.name: Redact
fields.doc:
Redact is retained and must be concurrency safe and honor ctx; nil
preserves the copied result. It runs once per first commit with the
trusted key tenant and subject and an empty Value.
fields.default: Redact is retained and must be concurrency safe and honor ctx; nil preserves the copied result. It runs once per first commit with the trusted key tenant and subject and an empty Value.

configs.name: quota.AdminConfig
configs.doc:
AdminConfig mounts administration routes on a caller-owned Echo group.
Authorization sees no target, so every route acts on any tenant: grant access
only to global operators. POST bodies must be application/json; prefer bearer
tokens to cookies. Callbacks must be concurrency safe; request cancellation
controls store calls. Input/store errors are sanitized problems.

fields.name: Limiter
fields.doc: Limiter is required, retained and caller-owned.
fields.default: Limiter is required, retained and caller-owned.

fields.name: Authorize
fields.doc:
Authorize is required and runs before parsing or store access on
every route. It must not retain c.
fields.default: Authorize is required and runs before parsing or store access on every route.

fields.name: Overrides
fields.doc:
Overrides optionally changes limit numbers for /usage; nil uses plan
values.
fields.default: Overrides optionally changes limit numbers for /usage; nil uses plan values.

fields.name: TopK
fields.doc: TopK is optional and caller-owned; nil makes /top return not found.
fields.default: TopK is optional and caller-owned; nil makes /top return not found.

fields.name: ErrorHandler
fields.doc:
ErrorHandler optionally handles authorization errors; nil returns
them to Echo.
fields.default: ErrorHandler optionally handles authorization errors; nil returns them to Echo.

configs.name: quota.Breaker
configs.doc:
Breaker configures a remote-store rolling failure ratio. Samples are bucketed
by Window/256 (at least 1ms) to bound memory. Calls whose caller canceled are
not counted; calls that outlive a caller deadline count as failures.

fields.name: Window
fields.doc: Window defaults to 10s; valid range 1ms–24h.
fields.default: Window defaults to 10s; valid range 1ms–24h.

fields.name: MinCalls
fields.doc: MinCalls defaults to 20; nonzero values must be positive.
fields.default: MinCalls defaults to 20; nonzero values must be positive.

fields.name: FailureRatio
fields.doc:
FailureRatio defaults to 0.5; nonzero values must be in (0,1],
excluding NaN.
fields.default: FailureRatio defaults to 0.5; nonzero values must be in (0,1], excluding NaN.

fields.name: Cooldown
fields.doc: Cooldown defaults to 1s; nonzero values must be positive.
fields.default: Cooldown defaults to 1s; nonzero values must be positive.

configs.name: quota.Config
configs.doc: Config configures immutable plans and synchronous hooks.

fields.name: Store
fields.doc:
Store is required, retained and caller-owned; Limiter.Close never
closes it.
fields.default: Store is required, retained and caller-owned; Limiter.Close never closes it.

fields.name: Plans
fields.doc:
Plans requires at least one valid plan; New copies all maps and
slices.
fields.default: Plans requires at least one valid plan; New copies all maps and slices.

fields.name: StoreTimeout
fields.doc:
StoreTimeout bounds each remote store call; zero uses 25ms, negative is
invalid, and caller deadlines always win. Local stores, such as memory,
run without it.
fields.default: StoreTimeout bounds each remote store call; zero uses 25ms, negative is invalid, and caller deadlines always win.

fields.name: DenyCache
fields.doc: DenyCache is off at zero; positive durations at most 10s cache store denials.
fields.default: DenyCache is off at zero; positive durations at most 10s cache store denials.

fields.name: DenyCacheSize
fields.doc:
DenyCacheSize bounds the LRU; zero defaults to 10000, otherwise it
must be positive.
fields.default: DenyCacheSize bounds the LRU; zero defaults to 10000, otherwise it must be positive.

fields.name: ReservationTTL
fields.doc:
ReservationTTL defaults to 1h and must be at least 1ms; size it above
the longest work plus settlement.
fields.default: ReservationTTL defaults to 1h and must be at least 1ms; size it above the longest work plus settlement.

fields.name: SettledRetention
fields.doc:
SettledRetention defaults to 5m, must be at least 1ms, and bounds the
idempotent retry window.
fields.default: SettledRetention defaults to 5m, must be at least 1ms, and bounds the idempotent retry window.

fields.name: SettleWorkers
fields.doc: SettleWorkers defaults to 4 (1..1024); the queue holds 1024 jobs.
fields.default: SettleWorkers defaults to 4 (1..1024); the queue holds 1024 jobs.

fields.name: Expired
fields.doc:
Expired settles reservations past ReservationTTL: Keep (default) commits
reserved amounts, Refund returns them. It runs on the next Reserve or Settle
in the partition and, with an Outbox, in the periodic sweep.
fields.default: Expired settles reservations past ReservationTTL: Keep (default) commits reserved amounts, Refund returns them.

fields.name: Outbox
fields.doc:
Outbox makes consumption and threshold events durable and is copied when
nonnil; with it, Hooks.OnConsumption and Hooks.OnThreshold must be nil.
New then starts background delivery goroutines, with partition concurrency
bounded by Outbox.Workers; Close stops them. Nil disables durable delivery;
Hooks then receive events at most once.
fields.default: Outbox makes consumption and threshold events durable and is copied when nonnil; with it, Hooks.OnConsumption and Hooks.OnThreshold must be nil. Nil disables durable delivery; Hooks then receive events at most once.

fields.name: Fallback
fields.doc:
Fallback applies only to remote buckets; remote counters fail open unless strict.
Fallback at zero enables local remote-bucket fallback with one instance and 100000 keys.
fields.default: Fallback at zero enables local remote-bucket fallback with one instance and 100000 keys.

fields.name: Breaker
fields.doc:
Breaker selects bounded remote-store failure tracking; zero uses
Breaker defaults.
fields.default: Breaker selects bounded remote-store failure tracking; zero uses Breaker defaults.

fields.name: Hooks
fields.doc:
Hooks contains optional retained synchronous callbacks; see Hooks for
concurrency.
fields.default: Hooks contains optional retained synchronous callbacks; see Hooks for concurrency.

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc: Logger is retained and caller-owned; nil is silent.
fields.default: Logger is retained and caller-owned; nil is silent.

configs.name: quota.Fallback
configs.doc: Fallback configures remote-store local buckets.

fields.name: Disabled
fields.doc: Disabled turns off local fallback; default false.
fields.default: Disabled turns off local fallback; default false.

fields.name: Instances
fields.doc:
Instances defaults to 1 and MaxKeys to 100000; both must be positive
after defaults.
fields.default: Instances defaults to 1 and MaxKeys to 100000; both must be positive after defaults.

fields.name: MaxKeys
fields.doc:
Instances defaults to 1 and MaxKeys to 100000; both must be positive
after defaults.
fields.default: Instances defaults to 1 and MaxKeys to 100000; both must be positive after defaults.

configs.name: quota.Hooks
configs.doc:
Hooks run synchronously, without panic recovery, on the calling goroutine.
Callbacks must support concurrent use; blocking delays the request. All are optional. Consumption and threshold delivery is at-most-once.
OnStoreError operations include admit, reserve, settle, usage, reset, shadow,
release, credits, expire and outbox.
A shadow-only failure calls OnStoreError once with a *StoreError and operation
shadow; live limit checks and Decision.Err are unaffected.

fields.name: OnDecision
fields.doc: OnDecision is optional; nil disables this callback.
fields.default: OnDecision is optional; nil disables this callback.

fields.name: OnStoreError
fields.doc: OnStoreError is optional; nil disables this callback.
fields.default: OnStoreError is optional; nil disables this callback.

fields.name: OnConsumption
fields.doc: OnConsumption is optional; nil disables this callback.
fields.default: OnConsumption is optional; nil disables this callback.

fields.name: OnThreshold
fields.doc: OnThreshold is optional; nil disables this callback.
fields.default: OnThreshold is optional; nil disables this callback.

fields.name: OnSettlement
fields.doc:
Lifecycle observations run once per normally returning call or worker job,
after existing hooks and cache invalidation. OnOperation runs last. These
callbacks count attempts, never consumption; application panics propagate.
OnSettlement is optional; nil disables this callback.
fields.default: OnSettlement is optional; nil disables this callback.

fields.name: OnCredit
fields.doc: OnCredit is optional; nil disables this callback.
fields.default: OnCredit is optional; nil disables this callback.

fields.name: OnRelease
fields.doc: OnRelease is optional; nil disables this callback.
fields.default: OnRelease is optional; nil disables this callback.

fields.name: OnReset
fields.doc: OnReset is optional; nil disables this callback.
fields.default: OnReset is optional; nil disables this callback.

fields.name: ObserveOperation
fields.doc:
ObserveOperation gates only OnOperation and its aggregate construction.
Nil observes every operation. It runs once per public operation or worker
job with that operation's context; a panic is recovered and means true.
Lifecycle callbacks are unaffected. It must be safe for concurrent calls
and should return promptly without retaining the context.
fields.default: Nil observes every operation.

fields.name: OnOperation
fields.doc: OnOperation is optional; nil disables this callback.
fields.default: OnOperation is optional; nil disables this callback.

configs.name: quota.MemoryConfig
configs.doc: MemoryConfig configures bounded process-local quota state.

fields.name: MaxKeys
fields.doc:
MaxKeys defaults to 500000; positive values bound each state
category. Negative values fail Validate and quota.New.
fields.default: MaxKeys defaults to 500000; positive values bound each state category.

fields.name: Clock
fields.doc: Clock is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.
fields.default: Clock is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.

configs.name: quota.MiddlewareConfig
configs.doc:
MiddlewareConfig binds a concurrent Limiter to Echo. Callbacks run
synchronously and must support concurrent requests. The request context
controls store cancellation. Settle jobs retain a cancellation-detached
request context, never the Echo context. The caller owns and closes Limiter.
Defaults are applied to a private copy. Concurrency slots are released after
the handler returns or panics, on the settle worker pool.

fields.name: Exclusive
fields.doc:
Exclusive rejects a request after quota middleware has already checked the
same Limiter. It prevents later quota middleware from checking that Limiter.
It cannot undo earlier usage. Skips and callback failures do not
participate; all Allow/Reserve outcomes do. State resets with Echo's request
state and tracks at most eight distinct Limiters per request. Conflicts
return ErrDuplicateAdmission; an Exclusive stage on a ninth Limiter returns
ErrParticipationLimit. Non-Exclusive stages beyond eight are admitted
untracked, as before.
Exclusive defaults to false.
fields.default: Exclusive defaults to false.

fields.name: Settle
fields.doc:
Settle reserves before the handler and asynchronously settles final costs afterward.
Settle defaults to false, charging usage without reserving and settling.
fields.default: Settle defaults to false, charging usage without reserving and settling.

fields.name: Unsettled
fields.doc: Unsettled defaults to Keep; it selects a policy only when Charge was not called.
fields.default: Unsettled defaults to Keep; it selects a policy only when Charge was not called.

fields.name: Limiter
fields.doc: Limiter is required, retained and caller-owned.
fields.default: Limiter is required, retained and caller-owned.

fields.name: Identity
fields.doc: Identity is required and resolves a trusted paying subject.
fields.default: Identity is required and resolves a trusted paying subject.

fields.name: Plan
fields.doc:
Plan is optional only with one configured plan; nil selects that
plan.
fields.default: Plan is optional only with one configured plan; nil selects that plan.

fields.name: Period
fields.doc:
Period is required for selected billing-period limits; nil supplies
no period.
fields.default: Period is required for selected billing-period limits; nil supplies no period.

fields.name: Overrides
fields.doc:
Overrides runs for middleware and UsageHandler; the app caches its source.
Overrides is optional; nil applies no numeric overrides.
fields.default: Overrides is optional; nil applies no numeric overrides.

fields.name: Shadow
fields.doc: Shadow selects a candidate plan for limit checks only; nil disables it.
fields.default: Shadow selects a candidate plan for limit checks only; nil disables it.

fields.name: Dimensions
fields.doc:
Dimensions selects trusted subjects in middleware; UsageHandler uses query values.
Dimensions is optional; nil supplies no dimension values during limit checks.
fields.default: Dimensions is optional; nil supplies no dimension values during limit checks.

fields.name: Cost
fields.doc:
Cost is optional; nil charges requests:1. Returned maps are borrowed
for the request and must not be mutated concurrently.
fields.default: Cost is optional; nil charges requests:1.

fields.name: Operation
fields.doc:
Operation defaults to the registered method/path, with automatic HEAD
using GET and unmatched requests sharing one operation.
fields.default: Operation defaults to the registered method/path, with automatic HEAD using GET and unmatched requests sharing one operation.

fields.name: Skipper
fields.doc:
Skipper defaults to never skipping; true bypasses quota
participation.
fields.default: Skipper defaults to never skipping; true bypasses quota participation.

fields.name: Headers
fields.doc:
Headers defaults to Draft11; Legacy, Draft11AndLegacy and NoHeaders
select other modes.
fields.default: Headers defaults to Draft11; Legacy, Draft11AndLegacy and NoHeaders select other modes.

fields.name: DenyHandler
fields.doc: DenyHandler defaults to the package RFC 9457 denial renderer.
fields.default: DenyHandler defaults to the package RFC 9457 denial renderer.

fields.name: UnavailableHandler
fields.doc:
UnavailableHandler defaults to the package RFC 9457 unavailable
renderer.
fields.default: UnavailableHandler defaults to the package RFC 9457 unavailable renderer.

fields.name: ErrorHandler
fields.doc: ErrorHandler defaults to returning input errors unchanged to Echo.
fields.default: ErrorHandler defaults to returning input errors unchanged to Echo.

configs.name: quota.Outbox
configs.doc:
Outbox delivers consumption and threshold events durably. The script that
changes state appends the event to the partition's store stream atomically,
so events are as durable as the store. The zero value is invalid: Deliver is
required. Defaults: 2 workers, batches of 100, a 1s poll and a 1m sweep.
PollInterval and SweepInterval must be at least 1ms. New copies the settings
and retains Deliver. The caller calls Limiter.Close to stop delivery. Close
does not cancel Deliver's context; Deliver must bound its own work and return
for Close to finish.

fields.name: Deliver
fields.doc:
Deliver receives every event at least once, possibly concurrently and out of
order. Return nil after durably handling it; an error retries with backoff.
Deduplicate by Event.ID. It must support concurrent calls.
fields.default: Return nil after durably handling it; an error retries with backoff.

fields.name: Workers
fields.doc: Workers defaults to 2; partitions delivered concurrently, 1..64.
fields.default: Workers defaults to 2; partitions delivered concurrently, 1..64.

fields.name: Batch
fields.doc: Batch defaults to 100; entries read per store call, 1..1000.
fields.default: Batch defaults to 100; entries read per store call, 1..1000.

fields.name: PollInterval
fields.doc: PollInterval defaults to 1s; index poll interval and the first retry delay.
fields.default: PollInterval defaults to 1s; index poll interval and the first retry delay.

fields.name: SweepInterval
fields.doc: SweepInterval defaults to 1m; re-index and expiry sweep interval.
fields.default: SweepInterval defaults to 1m; re-index and expiry sweep interval.

configs.name: quotaadmin.Config
configs.doc: Config selects a constructed limiter.

fields.name: EnableCredits
fields.doc:
EnableCredits exposes credit-topup and credit-correct. Mount then requires
Keys and a durable Audit sink or explicit AllowUnauditedWrites.
fields.default: Mount then requires Keys and a durable Audit sink or explicit AllowUnauditedWrites.

fields.name: EnableReset
fields.doc:
EnableReset exposes destructive partition-wide generation resets. Mount
requires Keys and an Audit sink or explicit AllowUnauditedWrites.
fields.default: Mount requires Keys and an Audit sink or explicit AllowUnauditedWrites.

fields.name: TopK
fields.doc:
TopK optionally enables the top-consumption view; nil omits it.
It remains caller-owned.
fields.default: TopK optionally enables the top-consumption view; nil omits it.

fields.name: Denials
fields.doc:
Denials optionally supplies instance-local denials; nil omits that
view. It remains caller-owned.
fields.default: Denials optionally supplies instance-local denials; nil omits that view.

fields.name: Backlog
fields.doc:
Backlog optionally supplies outbox observations; nil omits that view.
It remains caller-owned.
fields.default: Backlog optionally supplies outbox observations; nil omits that view.

fields.name: ID
fields.doc:
ID defaults to quota; use 1–32 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or
hyphens, starting with a letter, excluding api and assets.
fields.default: ID defaults to quota; use 1–32 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter, excluding api and assets.

fields.name: Limiter
fields.doc:
Limiter is required, constructed and caller-owned; keep it open while
serving.
fields.default: Limiter is required, constructed and caller-owned; keep it open while serving.

fields.name: Overrides
fields.doc:
Overrides optionally supplies read-only limit adjustments after
authorization; nil uses plan values. The callback is retained, must
be concurrency safe and must honor ctx.
fields.default: Overrides optionally supplies read-only limit adjustments after authorization; nil uses plan values.

configs.name: quotamcp.MiddlewareConfig
configs.doc:
MiddlewareConfig meters MCP tool calls with a quota.Limiter. Callbacks run on
the request goroutine and must support concurrent calls. Configuration is
copied by ToMiddleware; the caller owns and closes Limiter. Policies and
their cost maps are copied; callbacks are retained and must honor
cancellation. The middleware supports concurrent calls and owns no goroutines
or client lifecycle.

fields.name: Limiter
fields.doc: Limiter is required and caller-owned; quotamcp never closes it.
fields.default: Limiter is required and caller-owned; quotamcp never closes it.

fields.name: Identity
fields.doc:
Identity is required and returns the paying subject. It sees
authenticated data only: ctx, Caller.TokenInfo and Caller.Header,
never tool arguments.
fields.default: Identity is required and returns the paying subject.

fields.name: Plan
fields.doc: Plan selects a plan ID; nil uses the sole plan.
fields.default: Plan selects a plan ID; nil uses the sole plan.

fields.name: Period
fields.doc:
Period returns the billing period; it is required and runs only for
plans with billing-period limits.
fields.default: Period returns the billing period; it is required and runs only for plans with billing-period limits.

fields.name: Overrides
fields.type: func(ctx context.Context, id quota.Identity, plan string) ([]quota.Override, error)
fields.doc: Overrides changes limit numbers for one call; optional.
fields.default: Overrides changes limit numbers for one call; optional.

fields.name: Shadow
fields.type: func(ctx context.Context, id quota.Identity, plan string) (string, error)
fields.doc: Shadow selects a candidate plan for limit checks only; optional.
fields.default: Shadow selects a candidate plan for limit checks only; optional.

fields.name: Dimensions
fields.doc:
Dimensions selects dimension values, for example the model a tool will
call. It may read arguments; values select subjects, never the authenticated caller.
Dimensions is optional; nil supplies no dimension values.
fields.default: Dimensions is optional; nil supplies no dimension values.

fields.name: Policies
fields.doc:
Policies maps tool names to metering policies; unlisted tools use Default
with the operation Unlisted.
fields.default: Policies maps tool names to metering policies; unlisted tools use Default with the operation Unlisted.

fields.name: Default
fields.doc:
Default meters unlisted tools; zero charges one requests attempt with
no billable Cost.
fields.default: Default meters unlisted tools; zero charges one requests attempt with no billable Cost.

fields.name: Unsettled
fields.doc:
Unsettled decides a settled call that recorded no Charge, except a
ChargeFirst call that never started. Nil keeps the reservation, except
for input-required rounds, whose Cost meters are refunded. No refund
returns Attempt meters.
fields.default: Nil keeps the reservation, except for input-required rounds, whose Cost meters are refunded.

fields.name: Disclose
fields.doc:
Disclose adds plan and limit names, quotas and balances to denials.
Disclose defaults to false.
fields.default: Disclose defaults to false.

fields.name: ReportUsage
fields.doc:
ReportUsage adds the smallest remaining requests limit to the _meta of
successful results.
ReportUsage defaults to false.
fields.default: ReportUsage defaults to false.

fields.name: LoopBreaker
fields.doc:
LoopBreaker adds the attempt meter LoopMeter and the dimension
LoopDimension to every metered call, so a plan can limit identical calls.
LoopBreaker defaults to false.
fields.default: LoopBreaker defaults to false.

fields.name: OnCall
fields.doc:
OnCall observes each metered call after it ends; optional. It never sees
arguments or results.
fields.default: OnCall observes each metered call after it ends; optional.

fields.name: OnMeteringError
fields.doc:
OnMeteringError observes each eligible metered tools/call that obtains no
allow/deny decision, independently of OnError's once-per-plan-set reports.
Other methods, malformed pass-through requests and exempt tools are excluded.
It runs synchronously and must support concurrent calls; no context is retained.
OnMeteringError is optional; nil disables the callback.
fields.default: OnMeteringError is optional; nil disables the callback.

fields.name: OnError
fields.type: func(ctx context.Context, c Caller, err error)
fields.doc:
OnError receives callback errors, *quota.RequestError, settlement
failures and plan sets that break a policy; optional. Store failures also
reach quota.Hooks.OnStoreError.
fields.default: OnError receives callback errors, *quota.RequestError, settlement failures and plan sets that break a policy; optional.

configs.name: quotamcp.Policy
configs.doc: Policy is one tool's metering policy.

fields.name: Attempt
fields.doc:
Attempt is charged on every admitted call and never refunded by
quotamcp, so rate limits and the loop breaker see every attempt. Nil
means {"requests": 1}; an empty non-nil Attempt charges no attempt meter.
fields.default: Nil means {"requests": 1}; an empty non-nil Attempt charges no attempt meter.

fields.name: Cost
fields.doc:
Cost holds the billable meters, disjoint from Attempt. Attempt-counted
tools charge it when the request is allowed. Settled tools reserve it as an upper bound
and settle it with Charge; it is the only part quotamcp ever refunds.
Cost is optional; nil has no billable work meters.
fields.default: Cost is optional; nil has no billable work meters.

fields.name: Settle
fields.doc:
Settle reserves Attempt plus Cost and settles Cost with the actual.
Settle defaults to false, charging Cost when the request is allowed.
fields.default: Settle defaults to false, charging Cost when the request is allowed.

fields.name: ChargeFirst
fields.doc:
ChargeFirst declares that the settled tool's handler calls Charge,
Charge(ctx, nil) at least, before any billable work. Without Charge, the call never reached the handler because arguments were
invalid or the tool was unknown. Its Cost meters are refunded. A successful result
without Charge breaks the declaration: it keeps the reservation and is
reported to OnError.
fields.default: ChargeFirst declares that the settled tool's handler calls Charge, Charge(ctx, nil) at least, before any billable work.

fields.name: Exempt
fields.doc:
Exempt tools are never metered; they take no Attempt or Cost.
Exempt defaults to false.
fields.default: Exempt defaults to false.

configs.name: quotaotel.LifecycleConfig
configs.doc:
LifecycleConfig configures bounded call counters. Names are validated and
copied. With the zero value all names map to _other.
